errors.text_span: die Gebotshöhen in Eurocent pro Kilowattstunde (Eurocent / kWh)
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "Eurocent / kWh", not "Gebotshöhen in Eurocent pro Kilowattstunde (Eurocent / kWh)". The description incorrectly incorporates part of the chart title into the axis label description.

errors.text_span: bleibt konstant bis zu einer Bonushöhe von 0,3
errors.evidence: Referring to the light gray line (Durchschnittliches Brutto-Gebot Gewinner), the description states it remains constant until a bonus amount of 0.3. However, the chart shows the line is only constant until a bonus amount of 0.2, after which it starts to rise.

errors.text_span: Die durchschnittliche Netto-Gebot Gewinner-Linie beginnt bei einer Bonushöhe von 0 bei 5,0 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: The dark gray line (Durchschnittliches Netto-Gebot Gewinner) starts at a value visibly above the 5.0 grid line, approximately at 5.03 Eurocent/kWh, not at 5.0 Eurocent/kWh.

errors.text_span: steigt dann auf 5,2 Eurocent/kWh bei einer Bonushöhe von 0,4
errors.evidence: For the purple line (Durchschnittliche Stromgestehungskosten Gewinner), the value at a bonus amount of 0.4 is approximately 5.25 Eurocent/kWh (halfway between 5.2 and 5.3), not 5.2 Eurocent/kWh as stated.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis zu einer Bonushöhe von 0,9 konstant.
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the purple line (Durchschnittliche Stromgestehungskosten Gewinner). It implies that the line remains constant at the previously mentioned, incorrect value of 5.2 Eurocent/kWh. The line actually remains constant at approximately 5.25 Eurocent/kWh.
